items.raw_excerpt: A marcha foi realizada logo após o Dia Internacional da Mulher Negra Latino-Americana e Caribenha e o Dia Nacional de Tereza de Benguela, comemorados neste sábado (25).
items.summary_en: Hundreds of Black women marched through the streets of Rio de Janeiro on Saturday, July 25. The march followed the International Day of Latin American and Caribbean Black Women. Participants called for rights and a good life for all.
items.summary_ko: 7월 25일 토요일, 수백 명의 흑인 여성들이 리우데자네이루 거리를 행진했습니다. 이번 행진은 라틴아메리카와 카리브해 흑인 여성의 국제 연계에 맞춰 열렸으며, 참가자들은 모두의 권리와 좋은 삶을 외쳤습니다.
items.title_en: Black women march in Rio de Janeiro for rights and good living

items.raw_excerpt: Record numbers of Queensland women are starting apprenticeships in male-dominated industries, but experts say employers and governments need to do more to keep them in the trades.
items.summary_en: Record numbers of Queensland women are starting apprenticeships in male-dominated industries. Experts say employers and governments need to do more to keep them in the trades. The focus is on protecting female tradies from workplace sexism.
items.summary_ko: 퀸즐랜드에서 남성 중심 산업의 여성 수련생 수가 역대 최고치를 기록하고 있다. 그러나 전문가들은 고용주와 정부가 이들을 업계에 계속 남기기 위해 더 많은 조치를 취해야 한다고 지적한다. 여성 기술자들을 직장 내 성차별로부터 보호하는 것이 핵심이다.
items.title_en: More action needed to protect female tradies from 'nasty sexism', experts say
items.title_ko: 전문가들, '악랄한 성차별'로부터 여성 기술자 보호를 위한 추가 조치 촉구

items.raw_excerpt: El entrenador de Universidad de Chile explicó por qué el extremo argentino todavía no debutó y se refirió a la situación del defensor uruguayo, quien aún no firmó su contrato.
items.summary_en: The Universidad de Chile coach explained why the Argentine winger has not yet made his debut. He also discussed the situation of the Uruguayan defender who has not yet signed his contract.

items.raw_excerpt: Steve Harris was promised his flat-pack home could be a "build-in-a-weekend" job. It may end up costing him twice the sale price, with compliance costs added in.
items.summary_en: Steve Harris was promised his flat-pack home would be a build-in-a-weekend project. He now faces costs that may double the original sale price due to compliance fees. Consumer advocates say the marketing misleads buyers about true building expenses.

items.summary_en: Mayo beat Kerry in the All-Ireland football final to end a 75-year drought. One of the team's stars is now headed to the AFL.

items.raw_excerpt: If your ideal summer escape includes quaint main streets, beach days and plenty of small-town charm, you'll want to plan a road trip to this Ontario destination.
items.summary_en: Picton in Prince Edward County, Ontario is a small town known for charming main streets and beautiful beaches. The area offers soft sandy shores at Sandbanks Provincial Park and a quaint, storybook atmosphere. It's a popular summer getaway for those seeking small-town charm and lakefront relaxation.
items.summary_ko: 피크턴은 캐나다 온타리오주 프린스에드워드카운티에 있는 작은 도시로, 아름다운 메인 거리와 해변으로 유명합니다. 샌드뱅크스 주립공원에는 고운 모래의 해변이 펼쳐져 있으며, 동화 같은 분위기를 자아냅니다. 여름 휴가지로 인기 있는 이곳은 소도시의 매력과 호숫가의 여유로움을 선사합니다.

items.summary_en: Geoff Edwards was an Australian veteran who fought in the Battle of Crete during World War II. After the war, he created a small chapel dedicated to Saint John the Theologian in Western Australia. His daughter, Marilyn Sadleir, recently shared his life story with the community.
items.summary_ko: 제프 에드워즈는 제2차 세계대전 당시 크레타 전투에 참전한 호주 참전 용사입니다. 그는 전쟁 이후 서호주의 한 작은 예배당을 지어 성 요한 신학자에게 바쳤습니다. 그의 딸 마릴린 세들레이어가 최근 아버지의 생애를 지역 사회에 전했습니다.
items.title_en: The story of Geoff Edwards, who fought in the Battle of Crete, as told by his daughter, Marilyn Sadleir

items.summary_en: Empire magazine included a film by Brazilian director Kleber Mendonça Filho in its best films of 2026. The magazine praised actor Wagner Moura but mistakenly described Recife as a small city. The error angered local fans who know Recife is a major metropolis.
